links.outcome: Patient care-seeking intention (7-point) by AI integration intensity versus human-only vignette
links.effect: Versus human-only, low (β=-0.682), medium (β=-1.053), high (β=-1.267) AI intensity lowered care-seeking intention (all p<0.001); sharpest drop when the doctor deferred completely to AI.
links.quote: Relative to the human-only baseline, low (β = −0.682, p < 0.001), medium (β = −1.053, p < 0.001), and high (β = −1.267, p < 0.001) AI intensity were each associated with significantly lower care-seeking intention, demonstrating a graded negative effect.
